title: Manual Bahasa Cina
genre: Malay Afropop (Afrobeats pop with Malay melody)
subject: friends assembling a big trampoline for the kids at a Hari Raya open house, the instruction manual printed only in Chinese
caption: Malay Afropop, Afrobeats-pop groove with a Malay vocal melody. Clean palm-muted highlife guitar picking in thirds, a round log drum bass on the offbeats, busy shaker and a talking drum answering the vocal, soft Rhodes chords underneath. Warm sunny mix with a swung percussion pocket and a dry intimate lead. Male tenor, smooth light R&B delivery with a small call-and-response backing chorus. 104 BPM, A major. Rowdy, cheeky and sweaty. No autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drop, no amapiano piano stabs, no dangdut.
lyrics:
[Intro - highlife guitar and shaker, log drum enters]

[Verse 1]
Rumah terbuka, lemang dah sedia
Kotak trampolin besar macam pintu
Budak-budak menjerit, nak lompat
Kami buka, keluar seratus skru

[Pre-Chorus]
Manual dia, cuba baca
Semua tulisan Cina

[Chorus]
Manual bahasa Cina
Kami pusing atas bawah
Gambar anak panah je yang faham
Raya ni, kita main teka

[Verse 2]
Pak Long pegang spring, terlepas ke langit
Hafiz pakai baju Melayu, peluh basah
Ah Keong jiran datang bawa kuih
Dia baca, terus dia ketawa

[Pre-Chorus]
Kaki salah, terbalik semua
Buka balik, mula semula

[Chorus]
Manual bahasa Cina
Ah Keong baca kuat-kuat
Kami pasang ikut suara dia
Budak lompat, kita pun lompat

[Outro - talking drum and guitar, chorus hums fade]
